title: DocOps SPEC registry
description: Optional .docops-policy.json at a repository root, read from the inspected snapshot. The root-level SPEC.md is always the root SPEC and is evaluated exactly once, with or without this file; this file adds to it. `specs` registers further active tracks; `non_active_specs` lists, by exact path and with a reason, SPEC files that are not project specifications (test fixtures, historical material). Every tracked file named SPEC.md (case-insensitive, any depth) must be in exactly one category: the root SPEC, a registered active track, or a listed non-active file; any other is a FAIL that names the path. Whether a SPEC is active or idle is declared inside the SPEC itself, as `spec-state: idle` in its frontmatter (ADR-0013 Decision 1), not here. See ADR-0013 Decision 7.

specs.description: Registered active SPEC tracks, added to the root SPEC. An entry whose path is the root SPEC.md is the root SPEC under the track name it gives (not a second track, never evaluated twice). A registered path that is absent from the snapshot is a FAIL. An empty list registers no further tracks; the root SPEC.md is still evaluated.

path.description: Relative POSIX path from the repository root; no '..', '.', empty or '.git' components, no backslashes. Must be unique.

track.description: Track name, unique within the policy.

non_active_specs.description: Optional (a policy without it is valid). Explicitly listed non-active SPEC files, not evaluated and reported in the result. Exact file paths only, never directory prefixes. Each of these is a FAIL, not a malformed policy: a duplicate path, a path that is also in `specs`, the root SPEC.md, an entry without a non-empty reason, and an entry whose file does not exist in the snapshot. A policy that lists only non-active files and registers nothing else leaves the result what it would be without a policy.

path.description: Relative POSIX path from the repository root of a file that exists in the snapshot; same path rules as `specs`.

reason.description: Why the file is not a project specification. Required in substance: the loader accepts an entry without it or with a blank one, and the checker then reports a FAIL (NON_ACTIVE_REASON_MISSING), so a missing reason is never a pass.
